tagline: Discovery-first fanfiction search with prompt generation.
summary: A fanfiction discovery platform that searches existing tagged stories against complex, nuanced criteria before offering to generate a prompt. Tags are hierarchical with conditional branching rather than flat, so a search can express a specific premise instead of a keyword.
highlights: Searches what already exists before generating anything, so a reader is not handed a prompt for a story that has already been written.
Hierarchical tags with conditional branching express a premise, rather than the flat keyword lists other platforms use.
Returns both matching stories and an enhanced prompt with the novel parts highlighted.
Content grows through admin-curated submission, including a browser extension for submitting stories.
